from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEquity(BaseModel):
    """One company's ownership equity attributable to parent company shareholders from their financial report"""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/security code if mentioned")
    equity_amount: float | None = Field(description="The 'ownership equity attributable to parent company shareholders' value in yuan")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The date this equity value is as of")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_equity_list: list[CompanyEquity]
